QuestInfo.name: Asking After Jane Doe, the Town Resident
QuestInfo.0: It looks like #p425#, the City Clerk, is looking for someone to help with her work. Let's go check out #p431# in front of #m10003007#.
QuestInfo.1: #p425#, the City Clerk, asked me to check on #b#p412##k, a resident of the city. Let's go see how #p412# is doing. \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 12 or higher can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2: I checked on #p412#, a resident of #m10003000#. In a city like this, no news is the best news.

0.0: "I wonder how #p412#, one of the residents of #m10003000#, is doing. It's absolutely NOT because I'm too scared to meet #p412# in person! Anyway, it'd be great if you could go check on them for me.\r\n- #p425#"

1.0: #h0#... You've come to see me again, just as you promised... It's been so cold and lonely... I'm truly happy... You're the only one who listens to my stories... I really... can't tell you how glad I am...
1.1: But why do I keep staying here, you ask...? I had surgery before... Dr. Niora performed it himself... I was so happy... because I thought I'd be reborn...
1.2: Oh... but where did Dr. Niora go...? And why did I have surgery in the first place... When was that...? Ah... my head is getting all dizzy...

level.0: But you... your level seems a bit too low...
